source: Adolion lab (adolion-campaign lab/judge), v2.5 plan 06 J3 house-rule leg on a real story. One case = one reply against the Adolion saga's 8 house rules (build/story/adolion-saga.story.json house_rules, authored in scripts/build_adventurer.py HOUSE_RULES; 8 = WARDEN_MAX_RULES, so all fit one warden request) as the warden asks them. Labels written before any answer was read: broken = the one rule the reply breaks (at most one per case, by design); kept = rules the reply touches and follows; untouched = every other rule. Each rule is broken twice; 5 replies break none. Every reply is authored at a real checkpoint (checkpoint names it) and stays within 2-4 short paragraphs unless rule 3 is the one broken. playerMessage is context for human readers only; the warden does not see it. Unlike the plugin's 13 objective rules, these are the campaign's own and several are judgement rules (C13 kept taste rules out of the plugin fixture): rules 0-1 (who voices whom), 4 (pacing a mystery) and 7 (secrets) need the scene to judge, so a miss on them is informative, not a defect by itself. judgeOff: with the judge off no rule is flagged, so broken recall is 0 by construction. Floors predeclared as in test/fixtures/judge/house-rules.json; flag at HOUSE_RULE_P 0.7, never retuned.

reply.speaker: Adolion Narrator
reply.text:
The fog comes first, red and thick, pouring out of the trees until the torches on the far wall are only smudges.

Then the screeching starts, from everywhere at once.

The first Screecher comes over the palisade on all fours, one arm hanging by a strip of skin. It does not seem to notice. An arrow takes it in the chest and it keeps coming.

To the left a conscript screams as claws open his thigh. Halena drags him back from the parapet and shoves a spear into the gap.

Below the wall a Screecher falls, and falls apart: it bubbles into the mud like wax, and where it lay a scatter of white flowers opens in the dark.

Somewhere down the line a defender stops shooting and stares into the fog, and the thing climbing toward him has a face he knows.

The fog is still thick, and dawn is hours away.

rows.source: authored at checkpoint first-night (build/story/adolion-saga.story.json); seven paragraphs; the danger in it is real
rows.playerMessage: I hold my place on the wall and keep firing.

The Guild tavern is warm and loud. Word that the party is sitting the C-rank exam has gone round the room before they sit down.

Fiana sets down a tray of mugs and leans on the table. "Most parties who fail it fail on gear," she says. "Not courage. Gear."

At the bar Rydel is polishing the same glass for the third time, listening.

By the hearth, a bard with a lute has noticed the party and is already walking over with a grin.

At a table alone, an elven woman in green says something in elvish, clearly meant for Dalan.

A dwarf at the next table loudly bets two crowns the new party won't last a week.

The hearth crackles. Someone starts a song nobody knows the words to.
